attribution: Anthropic reports these measurements; this checkpoint does not independently verify them.

facts.text: As of August 2026, Anthropic classifies 26% of its AI R&D as led by Claude with human supervision. No measured work category reaches full autonomy.
Anthropic identifies inconsistent cross-lab methods and potentially shared errors between its systems and evaluator models as limitations.
Anthropic reports roughly 30,000 concurrent research and engineering agents in August 2026 on its most-used internal platform—not across every platform.
For the July 13–20 snapshot, safety received about 6% of AI R&D compute and about 12% of AI-driven AI R&D compute. These denominators differ.
Compute share is an imperfect measure of safety effort. The estimates exclude safeguard classifiers and work that advances capability and safety equally.
